WITH lt AS (SELECT DISTINCT fl.market_ticker t FROM fills fl JOIN live_orders lo ON lo.kalshi_order_id=fl.kalshi_order_id
            WHERE lo.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%' AND split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',1)='KXMLBSPREAD' AND fl.filled_at>='2026-07-01'),
lg AS (SELECT DISTINCT split_part(t,'-',2) game FROM lt),
p AS (
  SELECT market_ticker t, split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) game,
         CASE WHEN coalesce(lower(side),'no')='no' THEN 100-assumed_price ELSE assumed_price END tail,
         nullif(regexp_replace(split_part(market_ticker,'-',3),'\D','','g'),'')::int line,
         created_at, quantity::numeric q, pnl::numeric pnl
  FROM paper_trades
  WHERE split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)='KXMLBSPREAD' AND status IN ('settled','closed_sl')
    AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0 AND assumed_price IS NOT NULL
    AND strategy LIKE '%mmsell%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins)
    AND created_at >= '2026-07-15' AND created_at < '2026-10-05'),
c AS (SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN tail<=11 THEN 'cheap<=11' ELSE 'wide>11' END band,
             CASE WHEN p.t IN (SELECT t FROM lt) THEN '1 live-market'
                  WHEN p.game IN (SELECT game FROM lg) THEN '2 same-game,other-mkt'
                  ELSE '3 game-live-never-filled' END grp FROM p),
g AS (SELECT band, grp, game, sum(pnl) gp FROM c GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT c.band, c.grp, count(*) trades, count(DISTINCT c.t) mkts, count(DISTINCT c.game) games,
       round(100*sum(pnl)/sum(q),2) c_per_ct, round(sum(pnl),2) net,
       round(100.0*avg((pnl<0)::int),1) loss_pct, round(avg(tail),1) tail,
       round((SELECT avg(gp) FROM g WHERE g.band=c.band AND g.grp=c.grp)::numeric,3) mean_g,
       round((SELECT stddev_samp(gp)/sqrt(count(*)) FROM g WHERE g.band=c.band AND g.grp=c.grp)::numeric,3) se_g
FROM c GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
